items.title: #514: CSD tragedy
items.why_candidate: By now you’ve heard about the horrendous attack on the CSD pride march on Saturday night. A van drove into Tiergarten a few hundred metres away from the event’s locus at the Brandenburg Gate. A 65-year-old Polish woman was killed, 29 people were injured, including the deceased woman’s daughter.
